consensus_findings: Across lanes, FY2025 keeps Meta's broad privacy, content, advertising, and platform-regulation architecture while making AI a denser execution and governance exposure.
All lanes identify the April 2025 European Commission decision against the "subscription for no ads" model as the clearest newly concrete enforcement needle.
Multiple lanes agree that FY2025 adds sharper youth-regulation, intermediary-liability, AI-security, AI-IP, and metrics-methodology detail rather than a wholesale rewrite.
The broad 2024-to-2025 change is better read as a sharper risk stack than as a brand-new thematic map.
disagreement_findings: P2 is the cleanest first read because it most clearly ranks the named 2025 decisions and obligations above the repeated AI/privacy scaffold.
P1 stays useful on the same evidence packet, but it reads more like a broad sharpening than a prioritized decision stack.
P0 still catches the broad AI and enforcement turn, but it is looser about where repeated theme language ends and genuinely sharper specifics begin.
why_this_case_matters: META belongs in the public casebook because it teaches the difference between a repeated theme and a materially sharper decision stack. The value is not that AI appears again; the value is that named decisions, liability shifts, and AI-specific vulnerabilities now make the case more decision-useful.
investor_read: The practical shift is that FY2025 pushes Meta's AI and platform-governance exposure from a broad thematic backdrop into a denser operating stack. The investor question becomes whether European enforcement, Brazilian liability, youth regulation, AI-specific security and IP issues, and metrics-methodology pressure now matter enough to change how you read the filing.
protocol_read: Methodologically, this is a strong case for bounded comparison because the same tagged packet supports a better and a worse first read. P2 sharpens the 2025-specific decisions cleanly, P1 keeps the broad stack visible but less ranked, and P0 shows what happens when the control lane summarizes without the same discipline.
caveat: This remains a paragraph-packet case view. It supports a public judgment about claim shape, proof visibility, and where novelty claims should stop, but it does not prove a broader benchmark result or justify shipping outline compare here yet.
